name: Nimbus fixed-APY staking rewards priced from spot swap feed
summary: Nimbus StakingRewardFixedAPY and LockStakingRewardFixedAPY convert NIMB-denominated accrued rewards into GNIMB with PriceFeeds.queryRate. On 2022-12-01 the owner rewired PriceFeeds' NIMB and GNIMB feeds from owner-set static NimbusPriceFeed contracts to PriceFeedSwap contracts that return the live NimbusRouter getAmountsOut spot quote. The attacker staked through three helper contracts, and 8.6 days later flash-borrowed about 75,477 BNB, bought NIMB in the NBU_WBNB/NIMB pair to raise the NIMB/GNIMB rate about 42,000-fold, and claimed rewards that emptied all three staking contracts.

loss.notes: Other stakers' GNIMB taken from the three staking contracts. Their combined pre-exploit GNIMB balance of 16,480,792.579260974757935462 fell to zero. Excluded from loss: the attacker's own principal of 187,100.345016290273752920 GNIMB staked in 0x7d2d8d2c, and the 424.966629926279399044 GNIMB of legitimately accrued rewards returned by earned() at block 23886614. The attacker's GNIMB top-ups sent to the contracts in the same transaction cancel out in the balance difference. In the same transaction the attacker sold exactly 16,480,792.579260974757935462 GNIMB for 546.826074786203541275 NBU_WBNB (Nimbus-wrapped BNB, redeemed 1:1 for BNB), and that sale moved the price. The unit value is those proceeds per GNIMB sold, at the DefiLlama WBNB price. Attacker net profit was only 278.03 WBNB, because the NIMB pump round trip and flash-swap fees ate the rest. DeFiHackLabs reports ~76K USD.

ageReset.description: Owner 0x284d1e620bfbe77e7de522bc3e48f6097c7e970c called setPriceFeed([GNIMB, NIMB], [0x58edbb48887711e179e66c4e86351fd06af52a87, 0x199600cb7fdb1a72fc978f435e04b1cd1d260aa3]). pricesFeeds(NIMB) changed from static owner-set NimbusPriceFeed 0x5ee5c6bfe28b1cc47bea759a49c87226c4434137 to spot PriceFeedSwap 0x199600cb. With the static feeds, queryRate(NIMB, GNIMB) cannot be moved within a transaction.
Immutable PriceFeedSwap (router and path fixed at construction; multiplier never changed) returning the NimbusRouter getAmountsOut spot quote for 1 NIMB in NBU_WBNB.

limitations: Not the knot: deployed 61 blocks before target-1's configuration change wired it into PriceFeeds; it was unreachable from the staking contracts until then.

ageReset.description: StakingRewardFixedAPY converts accrued rewards with an unbounded, instantaneous rate: PriceFeeds.queryRate when usePriceFeeds is set, else router getAmountsOut, which is itself a spot quote. So its own configuration (priceFeed and usePriceFeeds set at blocks 23044984/23044985) does not decide exploitability.

limitations: Not the knot: deployed before target-1's configuration change, which created the in-transaction-manipulable rate this consumer read.

ageReset.description: LockStakingRewardFixedAPY has the same reward conversion as target-3. This target also represents byte-identical sibling 0xdef57a7722d4411726ff40700eb7b6876bee7ecb (created in 0x6412485d7cbdedef7e19c3f32dd885920eedaf0a82071b6c30502b34328cd248, block 23045051:4), which was drained in the same transaction.

limitations: Not the knot: deployed before target-1's configuration change, which created the in-transaction-manipulable rate this consumer read.

sources.note: Root cause and anchor. Verified source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode, chainid=56): StakingRewardFixedAPY 0x3aa2b9de (v0.8.7) and LockStakingRewardFixedAPY 0x70606571/0xdef57a77 (v0.8.15) have constructor args rewardsToken = NIMB 0xcb492c701f7fe71bc9c4b703b84b0da933ff26bb and rewardsPaymentToken = stakingToken = GNIMB 0x99c486b908434ae4adf567e9990a929854d0c955. earnedByNonce = rewardsTokenAmount * elapsed * rewardRate / (100 * 365 days), converted by getTokenAmountForToken(NIMB, GNIMB). That uses priceFeed.queryRate when usePriceFeeds is set (true, with priceFeed = 0xb8ac7fab, at blocks 23525438 and 23886614 on all three), otherwise swapRouter.getAmountsOut. PriceFeeds 0xb8ac7fab (v0.5.17) _queryRate = pricesFeeds[src].latestAnswer() * 1e18 / pricesFeeds[dst].latestAnswer(). PriceFeedSwap 0x199600cb (v0.8.7) latestAnswer = NimbusRouter 0x2c6cf65f getAmountsOut(1e18, [NIMB, NBU_WBNB]) * multiplier / 10000, a spot quote. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 23886615, index 36): attack contract 0x3c4e5b09 flash-borrows WBNB from DODO 0x0fe261ae, Biswap pairs 0xacaac931 and 0x8840c625 (logs 71-73: 75,477.26 WBNB), unwraps it into NBU_WBNB, and swaps 75477.264441336582134330 NBU_WBNB for 65344850.369813986 NIMB in pair 0x7d88a239 (logs 77-78; that pair's NBU_WBNB reserve was 367.9). Helper contracts then call getReward. Each staking contract calls 0xb8ac7fab.queryRate(NIMB, GNIMB), which calls 0x199600cb.latestAnswer, which calls router getAmountsOut on the pumped pair 0x7d88a239. The contracts pay 13855114.349895843169290048, 2733107.167676698874514882 and 1364999.511146764624384515 GNIMB (logs 82, 90, 94), against earned() of 327.96, 64.69 and 32.31 GNIMB at block 23886614. Before the lock claims the attacker tops up 0x70606571 and 0xdef57a77 (logs 89, 93) and 0x3aa2b9de for its principal withdrawal (logs 85-86). It then sells NIMB back (log 98) and dumps all GNIMB (logs 106, 120). Earliest exercise: eth_getLogs RewardPaid (topic 0x540798df468d7b23d11f156fdb954cb19ad414d150722a7b6d55ba369dea792e) on the three contracts, blocks 23044981..24500000, gives 965 events. The three source-1 payouts are the largest by more than 30x; no other payout exceeds 41,440 GNIMB. The seed transaction 0x7d2d8d2cda2d81529e0e0af90c4bfb39b6e74fa363c60b031d719dd9d153b012 (block 23639508) only buys 16.47/2.35/1.18 NBU_WBNB of GNIMB in pair 0x68d8fa8a and stakes it, with no price manipulation. The attacker EOA's txlist has no other staking interaction. The owner paused the contracts at blocks 23894659-23894669 and restored static NimbusPriceFeed feeds (0x950e203d..., 0xa53a63dd...) in 0x7df6e69ee5b613790df596393c5ebbf4f9af65cc745f6d965245cffa959fe05d at block 23901717.

Target identity and age. All four artifacts are top-level creations, confirmed by eth_getTransactionReceipt.contractAddress: 0xb8ac7fab by 0x83ba315a in source-4 (block 9545649:0); 0x199600cb by 0xf018fc65 in source-5 (23525378:4); 0x3aa2b9de in source-6 (23044981:2); 0x70606571 (23045159:19) and 0xdef57a77 (23045051:4) in source-7. eth_getCode is empty one block before each creation. keccak256(runtime) at the creation block equals the value at block 23886614: 0xdd8b04e5... (PriceFeeds), 0x73469342... (PriceFeedSwap), 0x9f0e7d0c... (StakingRewardFixedAPY), and 0x14a0c9b3... for both lock siblings. None is a proxy. Causal configuration: Etherscan V2 txlist for PriceFeeds, blocks 0..23886615, has 17 transactions. Earlier setPriceFeed calls pointed NIMB at 0x5ee5c6bf (0xf0220d87..., block 20979899) and GNIMB at 0x790aae1d (0x886a95ad..., block 23044471). Both are NimbusPriceFeed (verified v0.5.17): latestAnswer returns an owner-set _latestRate. Source-3 (block 23525439:98, owner 0x284d1e62, no logs) is the last pre-exploit call. eth_call pricesFeeds(NIMB) (0x2d485c5c...) returns 0x5ee5c6bf at block 23525438 and 0x199600cb at 23525439 and 23886614; pricesFeeds(GNIMB) returns 0x790aae1d, then 0x58edbb48 (PriceFeedSwap for GNIMB/NBU_WBNB, created 23525346). queryRate(NIMB, GNIMB) at 23525438 is 0.041756256366513875 (static), and at 23886614 is 0.069112824571024650 (spot). The later post-exploit restoration of static feeds (source-8) confirms that the feed selection decides exploitability. PriceFeedSwap 0x199600cb txlist has only its creation, so setMultiplier was never called. Staking txlists up to block 23886615 contain only user actions after the deploy-time updatePriceFeed/updateUsePriceFeeds calls (23044984/23044985; 23045162/23045163; 23045054/23045056); rewardRate and rewardsPaymentToken are unchanged between blocks 23525438 and 23886614. Knot = source-3: 1670989223 - 1669880788 = 1108435 s.
